title: Stability of de Sitter Space and Expansion at the Conformal Boundary
summary: Using an approach similar to arXiv:2409.15460, we give a new proof of the nonlinear stability of de Sitter space as a solution to the Einstein vacuum equations with positive cosmological constant in $n+1$ dimensions, with $n\geq3$. Using the gauge freedom of the equations, we are able to prove a precise expansion of the perturbed spacetime at the conformal boundary. In $n=$ odd spatial dimensions, the conformally rescaled metric is smooth up to the future conformal boundary and in $n=$ even spatial dimensions it is smooth if and only if the obstruction tensor of the boundary metric vanishes;…
